text:
Casey (Design): found an edge case where role inheritance diagram overlaps audit log link on narrow widths. current fix proposal: move audit link into the kebab menu when width < 720px.
Nora (PM): fine if we maintain discoverability—maybe add a caret hint in the row so users know more actions live in the kebab.
Ibrahim (SRE): if audit link is moved to kebab, ensure the pre-signed audit filter URL still works for deep links. some embed workflows start from that link.
Hana (Research): observed users expect audit access adjacent to counts. moving to kebab might increase time-to-task. suggest A/B test before permanent change.
a11y-bot: Accessibility impact flagged: moving links to menu may hide actions from assistive tech unless menu is clearly labeled. see checklist.
Casey (Design): alternative: keep visible audit icon but collapse label and make it an icon-only button with accessible label. that keeps it close to count but saves space.
Nora (PM): favor icon-only with ARIA label. add tooltip for sighted users.
Ibrahim (SRE): technical: icon-only button should still have the audit filter query param builder to avoid extra lookups.
Hana (Research): will run quick remote treejack to compare icon-only vs kebab move. results by Friday.
Casey (Design): will push icon-only mock and include hit area of 44px for touch.
Nora (PM): nice. ensure the icon sits before the kebab in dom order so keyboard users reach it earlier.
Ibrahim (SRE): noted. also can we debounce the audit link builder to reduce DB load on fast tabbing?
Casey (Design): done, will update figma and tag.
